content: WhatsApp group JID: opaque numeric string + '@g.us', modern groups look like 120363XXXXXXXXXXXX@g.us; legacy groups are <creatorPhone>-<creationTimestamp>@g.us. Individuals are <phone>@s.whatsapp.net. Since 2025 WhatsApp is rolling out @lid (Linked ID) participant identifiers that hide phone numbers; Baileys GroupMetadata exposes addressingMode 'lid'|'pn'. Store the group id verbatim; never reconstruct it.
